name: teahouse
sheet_order: row by row, left to right: frame i is at column i % sheet_columns, row i // sheet_columns
note: teahouse.png is frame 0, cropped like every sheet cell to the box x, y, w, h; draw at (x, y). Loops seamlessly over the frames with menu_layout.wind / sway: the noren billows and its panels swing apart, the lanterns swing behind the gust, the chime strip flutters, the chimney smoke leans and drifts, roof grass nods, the window light breathes; the grass at the footings uses the meadow tufts (meadow.F frames, the same gust phase as the scene's meadow). The ground shadow is see-through (ink at alpha 60 / 105).
